claims.claim: Foreign ministers from 32 countries including the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Australia published a joint statement on Monday condemning what they described as Iran’s use of violent attacks, covert networks and proxy actors.
claims.episode_span: Foreign ministers from 32 countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Australia, published a joint statement on Monday
claims.source_title: 32 Countries Condemn Iran’s State-Backed Threats, Cite RAF Fairford Incident
claims.supporting_quote: Foreign ministers from 32 countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and Australia, have condemned what they described as Iran’s use of violent attacks, covert networks and proxy actors to threaten their countries and partners, citing Tehran’s alleged involvement in an incident at the British Royal Air Force (RAF) Fairford base on Sept. 27.

claims.claim: The ministers recognised the United Kingdom’s attribution of Iran’s involvement in the RAF Fairford incident on 27 September and its assessment about the IRGC.
claims.episode_span: recognised the United Kingdom’s attribution of Iran’s involvement in an incident at RAF Fairford on 27 September
claims.source_title: 32 Countries Condemn Iran’s State-Backed Threats, Cite RAF Fairford Incident
claims.supporting_quote: The statement said the countries recognized the United Kingdom’s attribution of Iran’s involvement in the RAF Fairford incident and its assessment that the event demonstrated the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ (IRGC) continued willingness to conduct hostile activities beyond Iran’s borders through covert networks and proxy actors.

claims.claim: The joint statement said a recent campaign of attacks across Europe targeting Jewish communities, Iranian journalists and US interests was claimed by Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya.
claims.episode_span: a recent campaign of attacks across Europe against Jewish communities, Iranian journalists and US interests, which the statement said was claimed by Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya
claims.source_title: 32 Countries Condemn Iran’s State-Backed Threats, Cite RAF Fairford Incident
claims.supporting_quote: The ministers also linked their concerns to a recent campaign of attacks across Europe targeting Jewish communities, Iranian journalists and US interests. The attacks were claimed by Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI), according to the statement.

claims.claim: Andy Burnham said the IRGC were almost certainly behind threats to RAF Fairford, described as the firmest UK attribution so far.
claims.episode_span: Andy Burnham said the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps were “almost certainly” behind threats to RAF Fairford
claims.source_title: Tuesday briefing: Could Burnham take Britain back towards the EU?
claims.supporting_quote: Andy Burnham said Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps were “almost certainly” behind threats to RAF Fairford , the firmest attribution of responsibility made so far by the UK after an incident late last month.

claims.claim: The European Commission gave Cyprus a positive technical assessment for Schengen in July after 120 recommendations, and Nicholas Ioannides said on 1 October that all recommendations are considered implemented.
claims.episode_span: The European Commission said in July that Cyprus is technically ready to join the Schengen Area after implementing 120 recommendations
claims.source_title: What is holding back Cyprus's Schengen ambitions?
claims.supporting_quote: On October 1, Cyprus's Deputy Minister for Migration and International Protection, Nicholas Ioannides, confirmed that "all recommendations made by the European Commission are now considered to have been implemented."

claims.claim: Austria and the Netherlands have informally expressed reservations about Cyprus joining Schengen over the Green Line and British Sovereign Base Areas, without an official veto threat.
claims.episode_span: Austria and the Netherlands have informally expressed reservations over security concerns linked to the Green Line and the British Sovereign Base Areas
claims.source_title: What is holding back Cyprus's Schengen ambitions?
claims.supporting_quote: According to information obtained by DW, Austria and the Netherlands have already informally expressed reservations over security concerns linked to the Green Line, which divides the island of Cyprus, and the special status of the British Sovereign Base Areas .

claims.episode_span: allocated 323.3 million kroner, about 30 million euros, in 2027 toward a second orbital launch pad at Andøya Spaceport
claims.source_title: Norway Details Funding Allocation for Second Andøya Launch Pad
claims.supporting_quote: In its proposed state budget, published on 7 October, the government allocated NOK 323.3 million (€30 million) towards the project in 2027.

claims.claim: The education ministry said 130 of France’s 3,700 lycées were closed on Monday and that violence was intensifying while closures fell, as France prepared for Tuesday protests.
claims.episode_span: only 130 of 3,700 lycées were closed on Monday
claims.source_title: Live: France braces for fresh nationwide protests over school conditions
claims.supporting_quote: On Monday, only 130 of France's 3,700 lycees were closed, according to the education ministry, though it stated that, while "the number of school closures is falling... the violence is intensifying".

claims.claim: The Mexican army rescued 32 people by helicopter from a ranch in Ensenada, including 22 foreign nationals who included German and US citizens and missionaries, amid storms that killed at least five people.
claims.episode_span: German nationals were among 22 foreign nationals, a group that authorities said also included US citizens and missionaries, in a party of 32 people the Mexican army lifted by helicopter from a ranch in Ensenada.
claims.source_title: German nationals among those airlifted to safety as storms kill five in Mexico
claims.supporting_quote: The Mexican army has rescued 32 people by helicopter, including 22 foreign nationals, who had been trapped on a ranch in Ensenada. According to the authorities, the group included German and US citizens, as well as several missionaries.
